record.body:
## Rationale

Keeps decision finished-effort-derived intact and simple phases unaffected.

## Counter-argument

Gating finished on release would make finished mean proven for structured work, not just done.

payload.alternatives: Structured phases count as finished only when release is ready
payload.choice: A ready release shows a Release ready badge on the effort and its phase; the derived finished rule is unchanged

record.subject: release-ready-badge
